experimental_design.evidence: inferred: The patient and Cas9-corrected control samples were, respectively, labelled with TMT-127 and TMT-126 reagents

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Total cell lysates were prepared from 1 million RP11VS retinal organoid or RPE cells and the corresponding Cas9-corrected cells

number_of_fractions.evidence: The elution fractions were combined to 20 fractions, dried down by SpeedVac and resuspended in 20 µl of 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid (TFA).

number_of_technical_replicates.evidence: Peptides in each fraction were analysed in three replicates on either an Orbitrap Fusion or a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific), both of which are coupled with an UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
